description: x.md is a hosted read-only service that converts public X (formerly Twitter) posts, profiles, followers/following lists, and search results into Markdown or JSON. It also offers the same reads over MCP for agent clients.
summary: mdfromx.com exposes a public read-only HTTP API for public X content and a public Streamable HTTP MCP server; both are usable without authentication, with an optional manually issued bearer key only to raise search allowance.
